Equipment
 Pantograph Disconnect Switch
 220kv
 Z 245 with ES type ZE245 and
 GSSB-245, 1600A

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must performed every 
six months as indicated by M6 in the title block

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Salah Kamel Mostafa (HV-Dep. Manager), tested by eng. 
Sahar Mohamed Ali, accepted by eng. 
Sayed Mahmoud 
Hussein Farag; general director, revised by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng. Adel Abd 
El-Qader El-Nagar, approved by eng. 
Mokhtar Abdel 
Latif Mady head sector of Ataka PS.

This document accepted by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gilil: EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, and quality control general 
director and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses.
Isolation and proper earthing is required

There is danger of falling off the top of the isolator stack when cleaning 
 insulators or checking connections wear your safety belt.
Be sure that the isolator is disconnected from all electric power sources.

Make sure the drive mechanism is locked and the power supply for the motor 
 drive is interrupted.

Don't burn the cloth used in
 cleaning, collect it and send it to the dump.
Tool set for tightness
Cleaning materials (rags, cloth), soft cloth,
Safety belt, safety helmet, mask, ... etc
Voltage indicator.
Check all bolted connections for tightness.
Clean and re-grease all moving joints.
Check porcelains for chips, cracks, cementing, and fastenings.
Thoroughly clean all porcelain surfaces.
Check for signs of overheating or flashovers.

Smooth out any uneven spots and burn markers on scissors, earthing and fixed 
 contacts and lightly coat them with Petroleum Jelly (for Z 245 (AEG))

Clean the contacts and apply a thin and uniform film of molykote BR2 paste to 
 the contact surfaces (for GSSB-245 1600A (Hapam))

The bearing and gearing are totally enclosed and lubricated for life, hence 
 are maintenance-free over protracted periods. (for Z 245 (AEG))

It is recommended to grease the main bearings and the pivots of the coupling 
 rods using one of the following types of grease: Mobil (Mobilux 3) or Shell (Alvania 
 R3).( for GSSB-245 1600A (Hapam))
Check the state of the high tension terminals.
Inspect the equipment and the operating mechanism for good working condition .
Inspect and check all safety interlocks and test for proper operation .
Check the corona shield for damage (for GSSB-245 1600A (Hapam))

Introduction

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses.
Isolation and proper earthing is required
There is danger of falling off the top of the isolator stack when cleaning 
 insulators or checking connections wear your safety belt.
Be sure that the isolator is disconnected from all electric power sources.
Make sure the drive mechanism is locked and the power supply for the motor 
 drive is interrupted.
Don't burn the cloth used in
 cleaning, collect it and send it to the dump.
Tools and Equipment
Tool set for tightness
Cleaning materials (rags, cloth), soft cloth,
Safety belt, safety helmet, mask, ... etc
Voltage indicator.
Works to be Carried Out
Check all bolted connections for tightness.
Clean and re-grease all moving joints.
Check porcelains for chips, cracks, cementing, and fastenings.
Thoroughly clean all porcelain surfaces.
Check for signs of overheating or flashovers.
Smooth out any uneven spots and burn markers on scissors, earthing and fixed 
 contacts and lightly coat them with Petroleum Jelly (for Z 245 (AEG))
Clean the contacts and apply a thin and uniform film of molykote BR2 paste to 
 the contact surfaces (for GSSB-245 1600A (Hapam))
The bearing and gearing are totally enclosed and lubricated for life, hence 
 are maintenance-free over protracted periods. (for Z 245 (AEG))
It is recommended to grease the main bearings and the pivots of the coupling 
 rods using one of the following types of grease: Mobil (Mobilux 3) or Shell (Alvania 
 R3).( for GSSB-245 1600A (Hapam))
Check the state of the high tension terminals.
Inspect the equipment and the operating mechanism for good working condition .
Inspect and check all safety interlocks and test for proper operation .
Check the corona shield for damage (for GSSB-245 1600A (Hapam))
